By Shabiha Akter ,
59 minutes ago
Lakers Logo (Image Credits: Imagn) The Los Angeles Lakers have already navigated a challenging start to the season on the injury front. LeBron James missed 14 games due to a sciatica issue , and Austin Reaves only recently returned after his own injury spell. Now, Luka Doncic‚Äôs condition has emerged as the latest hurdle for the franchise.
After sitting out three consecutive games, Doncic is now expected to miss the upcoming matchup against the Dallas Mavericks.
‚Äú Luka Doncic (hamstring strain) will not play against Dallas on Thursday, missing his fourth straight game, sources told ESPN. He is still progressing in his rehab and hopes to be able to make an appearance in Sunday‚Äôs All-Star game for the World Team, sources said,‚Äù Dave McMenamin reported.
The Lakers and Reaves were reportedly hopeful that Doncic‚Äôs hamstring strain would not be a major one . However, the injury has continued to create uncertainty within the organization.
These health concerns recently forced Los Angeles to face the San Antonio Spurs without its star trio. The Lakers eventually lost 136-108 to the Spurs , as Victor Wembanyama dominated. Both James and Reaves have since been cleared. However, the team has yet to establish a definitive timeline for Doncic‚Äôs return.
Leading Vote-Getter Luka Doncic Racing Against Time for All-Star Appearance Luka Doncic (Image Credits: Imagn) Doncic‚Äôs injury has also cast doubt over his participation in the upcoming All-Star Game. McMenamin shared on ESPN that the Slovenian guard is highly motivated to get back on the floor. Luka has a special motivation for the honor of being the leading vote-getter for the first time in his career, potentially at stake.
‚Äú He certainly has some motivation to get back on the court in time to play in the All-Star game this weekend. He was the leading vote getter; that‚Äôs the first time that‚Äôs happened in his career, but that‚Äôs TBD ,‚Äù the reporter said.
The NBA‚Äôs newly formatted tournament has already drawn attention due to several prominent players being ruled out with injuries. Fans will undoubtedly be hoping that Doncic avoids joining that list.
